title: Adjudication
description: The graph's answer. Deliberately narrow: the agent must commit to one class, name a root cause, and cite witnesses by id. Free-form prose is not accepted as an answer.

verdict.description: The central distinction this project exists to make. `customer_behavior` means the number moved because people acted differently. `instrument_failure` means the number moved because our measurement broke. Conflating these two is the failure mode we are attacking. Two questions separate all four classes. First: did anyone intend the measurement to behave this way? If not, the class is `instrument_failure`, wherever along the path the arithmetic went wrong, and that includes a rule two models disagree about because nobody chose the disagreement. Second, if the behaviour was intended: did the intent itself change, so that one metric name now counts a different population than before? That is `definition_change`, and it requires a change to what the metric means rather than a discrepancy in how it is computed. `upstream_data_defect` is a measurement path behaving as designed over inputs that arrived corrupted. `inconclusive` is a real answer, scored as an abstention rather than as a wrong verdict, so prefer it over committing to a class the witnesses do not support.

root_cause_key.description: Machine-comparable slug matched against the case's ground truth, e.g. `collector_dead`, `tz_mismatch`, `bot_traffic_mixed`, `freshness_window_too_wide`, `below_fold_unreachable`, `detector_misaimed`, `collation_join_break`. Prose explanations are scored separately and never substitute for this key.

narrative.description: Human-readable explanation. Every factual sentence here must trace to a cited witness.

cited_witnesses.description: Witness ids. The scorer intersects this with the case's `must_cite` set to compute citation recall, and verifies every id exists in the ledger to compute citation precision.

refuted_by.description: Witness ids that argue against this hypothesis. An empty list means the agent dismissed an alternative without evidence, which the gate rejects.

alternatives_rejected.description: Forces the agent to show what it ruled out and why. A verdict with no rejected alternatives is a guess with a confident tone.
